notablePrerequisites:
Magosi has at least one eon counter on it and does not have summoning sickness.
It is your precombat main phase.
description:
During your precombat main phase, activate Contagion Clasp by paying {4} and tapping it, putting an eon counter on Magosi.
Activate Magosi's third ability by tapping it, removing an eon counter from it and returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
When Magosi leaves the battlefield, The Ozolith's first ability triggers, putting an eon counter on The Ozolith.
Resolve the Magosi ability, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Play Magosi.
At the beginning of your combat phase, The Ozolith triggers, putting an eon counter on Magosi.
Repeat each turn.
